My name is Jess Phoenix, and I am running to serve you in Congress because I believe that the future of our great California—and our planet—depends on the values my parents taught me: loyalty, bravery, and an unwavering commitment to truth. As a former field agent with the FBI, I learned how to protect our nation, but my heart has always been drawn to the earth itself. Over the past decade, I have worked on some of the most pressing challenges facing our world—studying volcanoes, earthquakes, and the impacts of climate change—while mentoring the next generation of scientists, educators, and first responders.  

Today, our district and the entire country are under threat from leaders who deny the science that safeguards our communities, our economy, and our natural heritage. We cannot allow the destruction of our parks, the erosion of our infrastructure, or the marginalization of our most vulnerable neighbors. We must invest in clean, reliable energy, in resilient communities, and in a future where every child can thrive.  

I am committed to fighting for a brighter, safer, and more prosperous tomorrow for all of us. Together, we can protect our planet, our families, and our shared future. Thank you.

Good evening, friends and neighbors of California’s 25th District. I’m Jess Phoenix, and I’m running to be the voice that protects the future we all share. I grew up hearing my parents describe the weight of duty – the courage to stand for truth, the resolve to defend what matters most. That same spirit has guided me through a career dedicated to understanding our planet’s most powerful forces – from volcanoes to wildfires – and to helping the next generation of scientists, engineers, and guardians of our natural world. Today, our beautiful California is being threatened by leaders who deny climate science, dismantle essential infrastructure, and harm the most vulnerable among us. We cannot let the same reckless policies that endanger our children’s futures be carried forward. With your support, I will fight for science‑based solutions, stronger disaster preparedness, fair and effective immigration, and a robust, sustainable economy that leaves no one behind. Let’s build a brighter, safer tomorrow together. Thank you.

This work motivated me to push for the structural change needed to create the hospitals Transgender Health Program. Over six years, I worked with colleagues to build a clinical program dedicated to serving some of the most vulnerable in our community. 

I do this all with the support of my husband, Ryan, who I met in college. We married in 2008 here in Massachusetts, fully recognizing the importance of equality for all.
